answer: Give every agent a willow wander audit. Each epoch the network hands each agent a fresh path of three checkpoints, each run by a different peer, and the agent must wander it, doing one real check per stop. Each stop stamps a mark that only fits that agent's own past work, so a copy fails at the next stop. Rewards stay locked until all three marks land; miss a stop and the payout freezes, miss two and it is out. Faking 1,000 agents means walking 3,000 fresh paths, about $6,000 per fake, $6 million per 1,000, assumed here. A fable says a forest is hard to fake because every tree is counted.
